claims.summary: The origin limits liability for electioneering communications to the sponsor, with exceptions for media that strip disclosures or create synthetic media; the descendant has no such provision.
The descendant defines artificial intelligence, commercial purposes, digital replica, expressive work, identity, and individual (a person domiciled in the state); the origin lacks these definitions.
The descendant defines internet, performance (digital replica substituting for a performer), and professional performer; the origin has no such definitions.
The origin places its information content provider definition within a liability section on interactive computer services, which also bars treating providers as publishers of others' content.
